about_the_game:
🧊 Frostborn

The North is calling. You awaken in a world of snow-capped mountains, dark forests, and roaring seas — a land where survival is earned, not given. Frostborn is a stylized Viking survival game that combines handcrafted exploration with deep crafting, modular village-building, and the brutal beauty of the frozen wilderness.

Forge your saga alone or with allies, carve out a settlement in the wilds, and uncover forgotten legends hidden beneath the frost.

🌲 Survive the Frozen North

The land is harsh, and nature shows no mercy. You’ll need to manage your health, hunger, and stamina to stay alive while wolves stalk the shadows and bitter winds cut through the trees. Hunt, gather, and craft tools to keep yourself one step ahead of the wilderness.

  • Hunt deer, boar, and wolves for meat, fur, and bone.

  • Forage for herbs and resources to craft potions and supplies.

  • Brave hostile weather and freezing nights with warm shelters and campfires.

  • Learn to ration food, manage wounds, and withstand the cold.

⚒ Build and Expand Your Viking Settlement

Claim the wilds and turn them into your home. Starting with a simple camp, you’ll eventually construct sprawling Viking villages with defenses, crafting stations, and thriving communities.

  • Settlement Marker System – establish a territory where your people can live and grow.

  • Modular Building – place walls, roofs, floors, and decorative pieces to create longhouses, watchtowers, and more.

  • Crafting Stations – unlock advanced tools with forges, looms, tanneries, and brewing tables.

  • NPC Villagers – recruit allies to gather, craft, defend, and expand your settlement.

⚔ Fight, Hunt, and Conquer

The North is filled with danger — from wild beasts to rival clans and mythical creatures. Combat is brutal yet rewarding, requiring timing, resourcefulness, and the right equipment.

  • Wield axes, spears, bows, and swords — each with unique animations and effects.

  • Hunt wolves, bears, and legendary beasts for rare drops.

  • Encounter bandits, rival tribes, and supernatural foes lurking in the dark.

  • Upgrade weapons and armor through smithing and enchanting.

🌍 Explore a Handcrafted World

Unlike fully procedural maps, Frostborn offers a carefully hand-designed world filled with landmarks, biomes, and secrets waiting to be uncovered.

  • Biomes: plains, rivers, pine forests, snowy mountains, and hidden caves.

  • Landmarks: villages, ruins, shrines, and strongholds.

  • Seamless Chunk Loading: only nearby areas load in, keeping performance smooth even in massive environments.

  • Dynamic Wildlife: from herds of deer to packs of wolves, each biome feels alive.

⛵ Master the Seas

The frozen land doesn’t end at the shoreline. Build and sail Viking longships across treacherous waters, discovering distant islands and trading routes.

  • Row or sail longships, adjusting to wind and waves.

  • Experience realistic wake effects and naval combat.

  • Dock at coastal settlements to trade, resupply, or raid.

🔮 A Living, Evolving Saga

Frostborn is being developed as a long-term Early Access title. We’re building this world with our community, adding features, polishing systems, and expanding the saga as players explore and share feedback.

Planned expansions include:

  • More settlement systems and diplomacy.

  • Advanced villager AI routines and factions.

  • Expanded quests and storylines inspired by Norse mythology.

  • New enemies, bosses, and biomes to conquer.

💬 Join the Community

We believe survival games are best shaped alongside the people who play them. Wishlist Frostborn now and help forge the saga of the North.

And if you want to be part of the adventure early, join our Discord community — share your ideas, report bugs, meet other players, and be the first to hear about new updates and playtests.

The cold is coming. Will you rise as a survivor… or be forgotten in the frost?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized violence, including combat with weapons against animals and enemy NPCs. Players can hunt wildlife for resources. Mild blood effects are present, but there is no graphic gore or dismemberment.

name: Frostborn

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 260X (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Designed for low-poly visuals, but survival AI and terrain streaming may tax older systems.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4–6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended for smooth chunk loading and streaming.

short_description: A low-poly Viking survival game where you build settlements, explore a handcrafted world, battle enemies, and uncover forgotten legends of the North.
